title: White-Haired Warrior in Red
description: Four nearly identical side-by-side panels show a confident dark-skinned woman with long flowing white hair. She wears a detailed red and black fantasy outfit with a long coat, corset, gloves, and boots, posed dynamically with one hand raised and the other on her hip against a dark studio background.
